assertion.statement: For the actual fixed eigenquotient and stipulated Atkin-Lehner eigen-involution, pi(Wx)=[w]pi(x)+pi(W infinity); the constant lies in the cuspidal image killed by the separate fixed C_pi.
assertion.objects: The fixed pi=alpha q_f based at infinity and the involution W of main3827.
assertion.hypotheses: Existing rational eigenquotient and characteristic-zero Q-isogeny alpha; W*(f dz)=w f dz as stipulated; W permutes cusps; the separate cuspidal torsion input supplies C_pi.
assertion.quantifiers: Every x on the actual modular curve and every W satisfying the stated hypothesis.
assertion.parameter_range: w=1 or-1; the actual fixed level N.
assertion.uniformity: One fixed cuspidal exponent works for these cusp translations.
assertion.constants: c in pi*omega=c f dz is nonzero and cancels; no value is needed.
assertion.normalizations: pi(infinity)=0, action on differential f(z)dz, no root-number sign substitution.
assertion.exceptional_cases: Does not establish a root-number formula or integral extension of pi.
assertion.limit_order: Fix quotient and differential line, apply stipulated W action, evaluate constant at infinity, then use the separate C_pi.

use.reason: Derives the conditional based involution formula from the actual quotient differential line, preserving the separately supplied cuspidal exponent.
use.shared_contract_justification: Main3827–3830 and the supporting note23–27 assert the same based quotient formula and cusp translation.

supplier.statement: For the quotient A_f in Theorem1, the pullback of invariant differentials is the span of the conjugate eigenforms; for rational coefficient field it is the line C f(z)dz.
